column1: 30101§compel§kəmˈpel§v. 迫使；强迫；使信服；引起（注意、兴趣）§Since NEC’s founding in 1967, its workshops and performances have given Black playwrights, including Walker, a forum for their compelling stories.§自 1967 年 NEC 成立以来，其工作坊与演出为包括 Walker 在内的黑人剧作家提供了发表自己那些**引人入胜**的故事的平台。§The narrator and Schmidt are both art critics. When my first wife admitted to Schmidt over dinner that she didn’t find art, painting in particular, especially compelling, Schmidt winced, set down his fork, and sighed dramatically; he then excused himself, explaining an appointment he’d forgotten about had suddenly and inexplicably been remembered, while making it abundantly clear there was no appointment at all.§叙述者和 Schmidt 都是艺术评论家。当我的第一任妻子在晚餐时向 Schmidt 承认，她并不觉得艺术——尤其是绘画——有多大的**吸引力**时，Schmidt 皱起眉头、放下叉子、夸张地叹了口气；随后借口突然想起一个早已忘掉的约会离席而去，同时又让人一清二楚地看出根本没有那个约会。§§compel sb to do sth 迫使某人做某事；compelling adj. 引人入胜的；令人信服的（真题 18 次全为此形）；compulsion n. 强制；compulsory adj. 强制的；义务的§§

30102§complication§ˌkɒmplɪˈkeɪʃn§n. 复杂化；使情况变复杂的事物；难题；并发症§While innovations to mitigate these challenges have been emerging—the use of autonomous delivery robots, for instance—success has been constrained due to the additional complications that arise (e.g., robots travel relatively slowly since they must navigate many ground-level obstacles).§虽然缓解这些挑战的创新不断涌现——例如使用自主送货机器人——成效却因随之而来的额外**难题**（如机器人必须绕过地面上的众多障碍物，因而行进相对缓慢）而受限。§While innovations to mitigate these challenges have been emerging—the use of cargo bikes, for instance —success has been constrained due to the additional complications that arise (e.g., cargo bikes must frequently return to depots to pick up new parcels).§尽管应对这些挑战的创新不断涌现——例如货运自行车的使用——但由于随之而来的额外**难题**（如货运自行车必须频繁返回仓库取新包裹），成效仍然受限。§§complicate v. 使复杂化；complicated adj. 复杂的§complication 指具体的「麻烦事、难题」，complexity 是抽象的「复杂性」§改译文：原译把送货机器人译成无人机，括号里的例子也是另一句的；改译文2：complications 是具体难题，原译「复杂性」不准

30103§concentric§kənˈsentrɪk§adj. 同心的；同轴的§For example, in his 1968 work Annual Rings, Dennis Oppenheim fashioned concentric lines that look like tree rings into the ice that covered a waterway.§例如，Dennis Oppenheim 在他 1968 年的作品《年轮》（Annual Rings）中，在覆盖水道的冰面上刻出状如树木年轮的**同心**线。§Social relations research commonly draws on a model that centers an individual within three concentric circles.§社会关系研究通常采用一个以个体为圆心、三个**同心**圆为框架的模型。§con-（共同）+ center（中心）+ -ic§concentric circles 同心圆（社科与艺术史常出现的空间模型）§concentric ≠ eccentric：后者是「古怪的；偏心的」，经典反义对照§改译文：原译把「覆盖水道的冰」说反了；改例句2：删去混入的 Text 1 末句和「Text 2」标签，译文2 相应删去前半

30104§confer§kənˈfɜː§v. 赋予；授予（优势、权利、地位）；商议；协商§In a discussion of the study, a student hypothesizes that small breeds of dogs (for example, bulldogs) must share a version that represses IGF-1 production that would otherwise confer larger body size.§在对这项研究的讨论中，一名学生提出假说：小型犬（如斗牛犬）必定共有某个基因版本，它抑制了原本会**赋予**它们更大体型的 IGF-1 生成。§Based on observations made over three years, scientists concluded that temperatures at the site likely confer reproductive benefits and that the site is used exclusively for reproduction—6,000 M. robustus adults, hatchlings, and eggs were observed at the garden, but no juveniles were present.§基于三年的观察，科学家们得出结论：该地点的温度很可能**带来**繁殖上的益处，且该地点专用于繁殖——在园地观察到 6000 只 M. robustus 成体、幼体和卵，但未发现亚成体。§§confer sth on sb 把某物授予某人；confer with sb 与某人商议；confer an advantage 赋予优势；confer status 赋予地位（真题常见搭配）；conference n. 会议；conferral n. 授予§§改译文：原译把「本会赋予更大体型」的主语误作基因，实为 IGF-1 的生成

30105§deviate§ˈdiːvieɪt§v. 偏离；背离§When Chen Zhao et al. analyzed U-238 concentrations and U-234/U-238 AR across vertical and horizontal gradients in Gahai Lake and Tuosu Lake in China, however, they found no significant deviation in values within the same lake.§然而，当 Chen Zhao 等人分析中国尕海湖与托素湖在垂直和水平梯度上的 U-238 浓度与 U-234/U-238 活度比时，他们发现同一湖内的数值并无显著**偏离**。§The table shows the average Mb levels and their standard deviations (indicating how dispersed the Mb levels of individual fish are in relation to the average) of three teleost fish species, as calculated by Daniel J.§表中展示了 Daniel J. 等人计算的三种硬骨鱼的平均肌红蛋白水平及其**标准差**（反映各条鱼的数值相对平均值的离散程度）。§de-（离开）+ via（路）→ 离开正路§deviate from 偏离（真题作 deviate from，不作 deviate to）；deviation n. 偏差（真题另现）；standard deviation 标准差；deviant adj. 偏离常态的；deviancy n. 越轨§§改例句：et al. 后漏空格

30106§distort§dɪˈstɔːt§v. 扭曲；使变形；歪曲（事实、声音、图像）§And even the hyperpop artists who don't rely on pitch-shifting, such as Shygirl, often distort their vocals using digital tools.§即便是那些不依赖变调的 hyperpop 艺人（如 Shygirl），也常借助数字工具对人声进行**失真处理**。§Dermatological researchers and geneticists make regular use of representative cross-sections of hair fibers, but such a cross-section can be obtained only if the strand can be cut perpendicular to its length without distorting the cross-sectional shape, which necessitates embedding the hair in a stabilizing medium, often resin, before sectioning it.§皮肤病学研究者与遗传学家经常使用毛发的代表性横截面，但只有当毛干能被垂直于其长度切断而不使横截面形状**变形**时，才能获得这种截面——因此切片前需要把毛发包埋在树脂等稳定介质中。§dis-（离、坏）+ tort（扭）→ 扭得走了形§distortion n. 扭曲；失真（真题高频）§distort ≠ contort：后者侧重「（身体）扭曲」，前者可用于抽象事物§

30107§domesticate§dəˈmestɪkeɪt§v. 驯化（野生动物）；栽培（野生植物）；使适应家庭生活§Dogs and modern gray wolves share a recent wolf ancestor from which dogs were domesticated.§狗与现代灰狼共有近代的一个狼祖先，狗正是由此**驯化**而来的。§A research team led by Ruiwen Fan may have solved the mystery, concluding that the alpaca is the domesticated form of the vicuña but that the modern alpaca gets only 64 percent of its genetic material from its wild ancestor.§Ruiwen Fan 领导的研究团队或许解开了这个谜团：羊驼是小羊驼的**驯化**形态，但现代羊驼的遗传物质仅有 64% 来自其野生祖先。§§domesticated animals 驯养动物（真题搭配）；domestic adj. 家庭的；驯养的；domestication n. 驯化§§

30108§embed§ɪmˈbed§v. 把…嵌入；使植入；使（观念、态度）根深蒂固§Walker and colleagues worked to modify Komagataeibacter rhaeticus bacteria to produce a pellicle with embedded pigmentation cells, thereby allowing the pellicle to "dye" itself from the inside.§Walker 及其同事对木葡糖酸醋杆菌（Komagataeibacter rhaeticus）进行改造，使其产出的菌膜中含有**嵌入**的色素细胞，从而让菌膜能从内部「染上」颜色。§Within selected summaries, researchers embedded markers of attentive listening (e.g., references to specific details), hypothesizing that such indications would positively influence perceptions of listening skill even in the context of disagreement.§在经过筛选的概述中，研究者**植入**了专注倾听的标记（如对具体细节的呼应），并假设即便在存在分歧的语境下，这类迹象也会提升人们对倾听技巧的感知。§§embedded in / with 嵌入…中；embedded adj. 嵌入的（真题主要形态）§imbed 是 embed 的异体拼写，现代英语以 embed 为准§

30109§encode§ɪnˈkəʊd§v. 编码；把…译成代码；对（信息）编码以便记忆存储§Only recently, however, have ethnographers started to recognize that many Indigenous songs encode and transmit valuable ecological knowledge—citing, for instance, songs of the Kwakwaka’wakw people in British Columbia, Canada, that share vital information about clam gardens, and those of the Kazakh people in Bayan-Ölgii, Mongolia, that explain the quality of foraging and water in different locations.§然而直到最近，民族志学者才开始认识到，许多原住民歌曲**编码**并传递着宝贵的生态知识——例如他们举出加拿大不列颠哥伦比亚省夸夸嘉夸族（Kwakwaka’wakw）人传递蛤蜊园重要信息的歌曲，以及蒙古巴彦乌列盖哈萨克人讲述各地觅食条件与水质的歌曲。§In a study of the evolution of DptA and DptB—Diptericin genes encoding antimicrobial peptides that combat pathogens and foster beneficial microbes in fruit flies (Drosophila)—researchers assessed Drosophila melanogaster resistance to pathogenic infections by Providencia rettgeri and Acetobacter sicerae, bacteria common in the flies' environments.§在一项关于 DptA 与 DptB 演化的研究中（二者是果蝇 Drosophila 体内的 Diptericin 基因，**编码**的抗菌肽能对抗病原体并促进有益微生物），研究者评估了黑腹果蝇对 Providencia rettgeri 和 Acetobacter sicerae（果蝇环境中常见的细菌）致病感染的抵抗力。§§decode v. 解码（真题另现 7 次，与 encode 成对）；encoding n. 编码；code n. 代码；密码§§改译文：原译是另一句（广告游戏）的翻译，按英文重译；补译文2

30110§engender§ɪnˈdʒendə§v. 造成；引发；使产生（情感、变化、结果）§By the mid 1980s, however, increased public awareness and environmental reforms, along with a decline in meat prices, engendered a natural forest regrowth, as evident by the .§然而到了 20 世纪 80 年代中期，公众环保意识的提高与环境改革，加上肉价下跌，共同**促成**了森林的自然再生。§Citing the uniquely absorbing nature of motion pictures, he contended that US propaganda should equal popular films in its appeal, entertaining audiences while engendering views of the nation as an ally.§他援引电影无与伦比的感染力，主张美国的宣传应与商业大片同样具有吸引力——在娱乐观众的同时，**塑造**美国作为盟友的形象。§en-（使）+ gender（产生）→ 使之生成§engendered 引发了；被引发的（真题主要形态）§engender ≠ endanger：后者是「危及」，形近异义§

30111§facet§ˈfæsɪt§n. （事物的）方面；侧面；（宝石的）琢面§This depiction of Hamilton establishes him as a compelling and well-defined protagonist but obscures other facets of the historical person’s views, namely his elitism and mistrust of the democratic politics of some of his contemporaries.§这一刻画把 Hamilton 塑造成一个引人入胜、性格鲜明的主角，却遮蔽了这位历史人物观点的其他**侧面**——即他的精英主义立场，以及他对同时代某些人的民主政治的不信任。§The book provides a multifaceted exploration of the concept of nostalgia.§这本书对「怀旧」这一概念进行了**多层面**的探索。§§multifaceted adj. 多面的（真题另现）；aspect n. 方面；dimension n. 维度（近义）§§改例句2：句末多一个句点

30112§feint§feɪnt§v. （拳击、军事）虚晃一招；佯攻 n. 虚招；佯攻§He was not running, he merely moved with a light-poised and watchful celerity, weaving among the calico rushes of the animals, feinting and dodging like a boxer until he reached the gate and crossed the yard.§他并非在奔跑，只是以一种轻盈警觉的敏捷移动，在花斑动物之间穿行，像拳击手那样**虚晃**、闪躲，直到抵达大门、穿过院落。§§§§feint and dodge 虚晃闪躲§与 faint（昏厥；微弱）同音异义；真题 feinting and dodging like a boxer 是明喻信号§

30113§fluctuation§ˌflʌktʃuˈeɪʃn§n. 波动；起伏；变动（数量、水平、情绪）§Drosophila (fruit flies) have generation times of 10-12 days, so seasonal changes in humidity and other environmental conditions can drive seasonal fluctuations in chromosome rearrangements in species such as D. persimilis and D. subobscura.§果蝇（Drosophila）的世代周期只有 10—12 天，因此湿度等环境条件的季节变化会驱动 D. persimilis 与 D. subobscura 等物种染色体重排的季节性**波动**。§A second research team has therefore hypothesized that in low visibility, a fish will be more likely to avoid an obstruction when the associated pressure fluctuations at the fish's snout are greater.§因此，第二支研究团队提出假设：在低能见度下，与障碍物相关的鱼吻压力**波动**越大，鱼越可能避开障碍物。§§seasonal fluctuations 季节性波动（真题搭配）；fluctuate v. 波动（真题另现 7 次）§fluctuation 指上下起伏，flux 强调持续不断的变化状态§改译文：chromosome rearrangements 是「染色体重排」，原译「倒位」不准

30114§foreground§ˈfɔːɡraʊnd§v. 使突出；把…置于显著位置 n. （画面的）前景；（讨论的）核心位置§So George Inness’s decision to foreground a railroad in his 1855 painting The Lackawanna Valley is notable, since images of railroads often alluded to the destruction of wilderness in the name of progress.§因此，乔治·英尼斯 1855 年在画作《拉克瓦纳山谷》中把一条铁路**置于前景**，这一点颇为引人注目——因为铁路形象在当时往往暗指以进步之名对荒野的破坏。§Such an analysis of Anne Vallaye-Coster's Still Life with Lobster might consider how the painting's sharply contrasting colors place primary emphasis on the lobster in the foreground.§对 Anne Vallaye-Coster《龙虾静物画》的这种分析，或可考察画中强烈的色彩对比如何把主要重心放在**前景**的龙虾上。§§foregrounding n. 前景化（文学 / 艺术批评术语）；background n. 背景（反义对照）§§改例句2：句末多余的「 .」

30115§germinate§ˈdʒɜːmɪneɪt§v. （种子）发芽；萌发；（想法、情感）开始发展；萌芽§You might think the answer to these questions is obviously no, but researchers in the Netherlands recently showed that the seeds of many common plant species can germinate in soil designed to simulate Martian conditions, as long as water is supplied.§你也许以为这些问题的答案显然是否定的，但荷兰的研究者最近证明：只要供水充足，许多常见植物的种子能够在模拟火星环境的土壤中**发芽**。§Of these, 180 seeds (60%) germinated.§其中 180 粒种子（60%）**发了芽**。§§germination n. 发芽（真题另现 11 次）；germ n. 胚芽；病菌（同根异义）§§改例句2：句末多余的「 .」

30116§handedness§ˈhændɪdnəs§n. 利手性；惯用左 / 右手的偏侧性§Humans are overwhelmingly right‑hand dominant (85‑90%) and can thus be said to exhibit strong population‑level right handedness (PLRH).§人类绝大多数惯用右手（85–90%），因此可以说表现出很强的群体层面右**利手偏向**（PLRH）。§However, the latter study included only 14 individuals, and a meta-analysis of primate-laterality studies demonstrated that a minimum sample size of 176 individuals is required to be confident that a finding of population-level handedness is not mere statistical noise.§然而后者只纳入了 14 个个体；而对灵长类偏侧性研究的元分析表明，要确信「种群级别的**利手偏好**」并非统计噪声，至少需要 176 个个体的样本。§§population-level handedness 群体层面的利手偏向（PLRH 即 population-level right handedness）；laterality n. 偏侧性（真题同义术语）；ambidextrous adj. 双手都灵巧的（反义相关词）§§

30117§heretofore§ˌhɪətuˈfɔː§adv. 迄今；在此之前§Distant reading, or computer-assisted quantitative analysis of massive collections of digitized texts, can reveal stylistic elements that have heretofore escaped notice, despite being shared by numerous texts from the modernist period.§远读（即借助计算机对海量数字化文本进行量化分析）能够揭示出**迄今为止**一直被忽视的风格要素——尽管现代主义时期的众多文本其实共享这些要素。§§§§henceforth adv. 从此以后（方向相反，真题另现）；theretofore adv. 直到那时§正式 / 法律语体，相当于 until now；日常英语多用 until now / previously§改译文：删去英文里没有的「文本二：」

30118§immerse§ɪˈmɜːs§v. 使浸没（于液体中）；使沉浸；使专心于§Today's theater stages are frequently filled with props and scenery to immerse the audience in a play's world.§如今的戏剧舞台常常摆满道具与布景，让观众**沉浸**于剧作的世界。§After traveling to the United States and Europe in the early 1930s and immersing himself in an international architectural discourse, Barragán began incorporating principles derived from functionalism and modernism in his work, as seen in the apartment building for José Mojica, whose unadorned geometric forms contrast with the historically inspired architecture found in the Harper de Garibi House, one of Barragán's early projects in Guadalajara.§1930 年代初游历美国与欧洲、并**沉浸**于国际建筑话语之后，巴拉干开始把源自功能主义与现代主义的原则纳入自己的作品，这可见于为何塞·莫希卡设计的公寓楼——其不加修饰的几何形式，与瓜达拉哈拉早期项目 Harper de Garibi 住宅的历史风格建筑形成对比。§§immerse oneself in 沉浸于（如 a discourse / culture）；immersion n. 沉浸；immersed adj. 专注的§immerse ≠ emerge：后者是「出现、浮现」，方向相反§

30119§implicitly§ɪmˈplɪsɪtli§adv. 含蓄地；暗示地；绝对地；毫无保留地§Thomas Piketty and other historians of capitalism rarely discuss domestic capitalism in Africa before the period of European colonization, implicitly presenting capitalism as external to and imposed on Africa.§托马斯·皮凯蒂等资本主义史学家很少讨论欧洲殖民时期之前非洲本土的资本主义，这就**含蓄地**把资本主义呈现为外在于非洲、并被强加于非洲的东西。§§§§implicitly trust 完全信任；implicit adj. 含蓄的；不言明的；explicitly adv. 明确地（反义）§implied 强调「被暗示出来的」，implicit 强调「内含的」§

30120§interbreed§ˌɪntəˈbriːd§v. （不同种群、物种之间）杂交繁殖§Predating the European colonization of Peru, the Chiribaya dog vanished due to interbreeding with dogs brought from Europe.§奇里巴亚犬（Chiribaya dog）在欧洲人殖民秘鲁之前就已存在，后来因与欧洲人带来的狗**杂交**而消失。§§§inter-（相互、之间）+ breed（繁殖）§interbreeding n. 杂交；interbred adj. 杂交的；breed v. 繁殖 n. 品种（真题高频基础词）§§

30121§liability§ˌlaɪəˈbɪləti§n. 负债；（法律）责任；赔偿责任；负担；累赘§Companies involved in petroleum distribution hold petroleum stockpiles among their assets, which as social attitudes increasingly favor using less carbon-intensive sources of energy, could become liabilities if their market value falls below what companies have invested to acquire and maintain them.§从事石油分销的公司把石油储备列为资产；随着社会态度日益倾向使用碳强度更低的能源，一旦其市值跌破公司为购置和维护这些储备所投入的成本，它们就可能变成**负债**。§But petroleum extraction is a very carbon-intensive industry, so as social attitudes increasingly favor using less carbon-intensive sources of energy, demand for petroleum falls and the drilling equipment will eventually, or even suddenly, become a liability as reduced petroleum prices make it more difficult to recover the expense of maintaining such equipment.§但石油开采是高度碳密集型产业，随着社会态度日益青睐低碳能源，石油需求下降，钻井设备终将——甚至可能突然——沦为**负资产**：油价走低使收回设备维护成本愈发困难。§§legal liability 法律责任；assume liability 承担责任；become a liability 成为负担§会计语境中指企业须偿付的债务，与 asset（资产）相对§

30122§mammoth§ˈmæməθ§n. 猛犸象 adj. 巨大的；庞大的§Researchers have long hypothesized that woolly mammoths were hunted to extinction in North America by humans using spears with grooved tips known as Clovis points.§研究者长期以来假设：北美的长毛**猛犸象**是被使用带槽矛尖（即克洛维斯矛尖）的人类猎杀至灭绝的。§In 2014, Marianne Dehasque et al. challenged earlier theories on causes of woolly mammoth extinction that emphasized isolation and inbreeding and a resulting increase in genetic variation and increase in chances of harmful genetic mutations.§2014 年，Marianne Dehasque 等人向先前强调「隔离与近交、遗传变异增加及有害突变概率上升」的长毛**猛犸象**灭绝理论发起了挑战。§§woolly mammoth 长毛猛犸象（真题搭配）；a mammoth task 艰巨的任务§mammoth ≠ mammon：后者是「财富（被视为罪恶）」，文学用词§

30123§melancholy§ˈmelənkəli§n. 忧郁；愁绪；伤感 adj. 忧郁的；令人伤感的§He surveyed the fence, and all gladness left him and a deep melancholy settled down upon his spirit.§他打量着那道栅栏，所有的欢愉都离他而去，一种深沉的**忧郁**沉沉地压上他的心头。§§§§melancholic adj. 忧郁的；melancholia n. 忧郁症§§

30124§mingle§ˈmɪŋɡl§v. （使）混合；交融；与人交往；应酬§My spirit swoons, and all my senses cry For Ocean's breast and covering of the sky. Rock me to sleep, ye waves, and outward bound, Just let me drift far out from toil and care,Where lapping of the waves shall be the sound, Which mingled with the winds that gently bear Me on between a peaceful sea and sky, To make my soothing slumberous lullaby.§我的神魂昏沉，百骸齐呼，要大海的胸膛与天空的覆被。摇我入眠吧，浪涛，任我向外漂去，远远离开劳苦与忧烦；拍岸的浪声与轻拂的风**交融**在一起，载我行于平静的海天之间，织成一支抚人入眠的催眠曲。§Brown with a mingled feeling of respect and admiration.§Brown 心中**交织**着敬意与钦佩。§§mingle with 与…混合；与…交往（如 mingle with the guests）；intermingle v. 相互混合（同义，语气更强）§mingle ≠ mangle：后者是「撕裂、严重损坏」，形近异义§改例句：诗行换行处漏空格（cryFor、bound,Just、sound,Which、bearMe、sky,To）

30125§minimalist§ˈmɪnɪməlɪst§n. 极简主义者 adj. 极简主义的（艺术、音乐、设计）§Belonging to neither the minimalist nor the abstract art movements but heavily influencing both, Constantin Brâncuși spent his sculpting career returning to the same few themes—a kiss, a sleeping head, and a bird in flight—each rendered in pristine, simple, almost abstract forms.§康斯坦丁·布朗库西既不属于**极简主义**也不属于抽象艺术运动，却对两者影响深远；他的雕塑生涯不断回到同样的几个主题——一个吻、一颗沉睡的头颅、一只飞翔的鸟——每一个都以纯净、简洁、近乎抽象的形态呈现。§Thus his minimalist style is central to his storytelling.§因此，他的**极简主义**风格正是其叙事的核心。§§minimalism n. 极简主义；minimal adj. 最小的；the minimalist movement 极简主义运动（真题搭配）§minimalist 是一种风格派别，minimal 只是「最少的」§改译文：句末残缺带方括号，补全 pristine, simple, almost abstract forms

30126§mischievous§ˈmɪstʃɪvəs§adj. 爱恶作剧的；淘气的；（后果）恶意的；惹麻烦的§Davis focuses on how Rainey and Smith improvised the lyrics — replacing the original lines with mischievous jokes and wordplay.§Davis 重点分析 Rainey 与 Smith 如何即兴改词——把原词换成**调皮**的玩笑和文字游戏。§Aunt Polly is having dinner with Tom, her mischievous young nephew.§波莉姨妈正和她**顽皮**的小侄子汤姆一起吃晚饭。§§mischievous jokes 调皮的玩笑§重音在第一音节，注意拼写 mis-chie-vous§

30127§novella§nəˈvelə§n. 中篇小说§By featuring main characters who are Blackfeet, like Jones himself, the novella also helped to ensure that Indigenous people have a place within the horror genre.§由于主角是与琼斯本人同属黑脚族的原住民，这部**中篇小说**也有助于确保原住民在恐怖小说这一类型中占有一席之地。§His acclaimed 2013 novella Him Standing is set in an urban Indigenous community in Canada.§他广受好评的 2013 年**中篇小说** Him Standing 以加拿大的一个城市原住民社区为背景。§§novel n. 长篇小说 adj. 新奇的（同一拼写两义）§novel 长篇小说，novelette 中短篇小说（有时含贬义）；novella 与 nova（天文学「新星」）形近§

30128§noxious§ˈnɒkʃəs§adj. 有毒的；有害的；令人厌恶的；道德上有害的§Some scientists have hypothesized that this capability evolved because it imposes a lower metabolic cost than does the alternative mechanism of producing chemicals that render moths noxious to bats.§一些科学家假设，这一能力之所以演化出来，是因为它比另一种机制——制造化学物质使蛾子对蝙蝠而言**有毒**——所需的代谢成本更低。§Kendall et al. found that Yponomeuta padella, a species of small-bodied moths that produces noxious substances, emits ultrasonic pulses that closely resemble the acoustic aposematic signals of Arctia villica, a noxious moth species in the large-bodied Arctiinae family whose distribution overlaps with that of Y. padella.§Kendall 等人发现：会产生**有毒**物质的小型蛾类 Yponomeuta padella 发出的超声波脉冲，与灯蛾科大型有毒蛾类 Arctia villica 的声音警戒信号十分相似——后者的分布区与前者重叠。§§toxic / poisonous adj. 有毒的（近义替换）§noxious ≠ obnoxious：后者是「惹人讨厌的」，形近异义§改译文：noxious to bats 原译「难吃」，改为「有毒」；改例句2：et al. 与 Y. 后漏空格；改译文2：原译「不产生有毒物质」与英文相反

30129§observant§əbˈzɜːvənt§adj. 观察力敏锐的；善于观察的；留心的§They concluded that the mating environment hypothesis is not well supported by their observational data.§他们得出结论：交配环境假说并未得到其**观察**数据的有力支持。§§§§become more observant 变得更留心；observe v. 观察；observation n. 观察；observational adj. 观察性的（真题三形皆现）；perceptive adj. 有洞察力的；attentive adj. 专心的（近义）§observant（善于观察的）≠ observational（观察性的，形容研究，本例句即此形）；observant ≠ observance：后者是「遵守；仪式」§

30130§perforate§ˈpɜːfəreɪt§v. 在…上打孔；使穿孔§Eventually, as evidenced by artifacts at Xiaogushan in East Asia, someone perforated the end of a bone awl to make an eye (hole) to hold the cord, thereby creating a sewing needle with which both steps could be performed in a single motion.§最终，正如东亚小孤山出土器物所显示的那样，有人在骨锥的末端**钻出**一个孔（眼）来穿线，由此造出了缝衣针——有了它，两道工序可以一气呵成。§Eventually, people made needles by perforating the end of a bone awl with an eye (hole) to hold the cord, thereby enabling the simultaneous performance of the previously separate actions of puncturing and threading.§最终，人们在骨锥末端**穿孔**、做出穿线用的针眼（孔）来制作针，从而让原本分开的扎孔与穿线两个动作得以同时完成。§§perforated adj. 带孔的；穿孔的；perforation n. 孔眼；穿孔（亦指邮票齿孔）§penetrate 是「穿透」，不必留下孔洞§补译文2

30131§periodical§ˌpɪəriˈɒdɪkl§n. 期刊；定期出版物 adj. 定期的；周期的§Gustav Frank and Madleen Podewski have observed that although serialized publication and a commercial focus mark periodicals as quite distinct from other objects of literary analysis, the periodical is insufficiently theorized as a unique form, leaving scholars heavily reliant on methods of literary criticism developed for analyzing other types of texts, as well as methods arising from other fields entirely, such as visual studies.§Gustav Frank 和 Madleen Podewski 指出，尽管连载出版与商业导向使**期刊**与其他文学分析对象截然不同，期刊作为一种独特形式却缺乏充分的理论化，致使学者严重依赖为分析其他类型文本而发展出的文学批评方法，以及完全来自其他领域（如视觉研究）的方法。§As can be seen in the case of The Egoist, a London magazine published from January 1914 to December 1919, some small periodicals influential in the development of the modernist movement have been explored in depth by scholars.§从 1914 年 1 月至 1919 年 12 月在伦敦出版的杂志《利己主义者》（The Egoist）一例可以看出，一些对现代主义运动发展颇具影响力的小型**期刊**已被学者深入研究。§§periodic adj. 周期的；periodically adv. 定期地§period 是「时期」，periodical 是「期刊」§改译文：原译是另一句（Whitmore 与流散诗）的翻译，按英文重译

30132§placid§ˈplæsɪd§adj. 平静的；宁静的；温和的；不易动怒的§Some art historians suggest that Highwaymen paintings played a role in shaping popular perceptions of the state that persist today: the natural iconography that McLendon and colleagues constantly revisited—placid inland rivers, windswept palm trees—is now seen as classically Floridian.§一些艺术史学者认为，「公路画家」（the Highwaymen）的画作塑造了公众对佛罗里达州延续至今的印象：McLendon 及其同伴反复描绘的自然意象——**平静**的内陆河流、迎风的棕榈——如今被视为典型的佛罗里达风物。§The mood in the paintings is placid.§这些画作的情绪基调是**宁静**的。§§a placid temperament 温和的性情；placidity n. 平静；placidly adv. 平静地§与 placate（安抚）同根（plac- 取悦、安抚）§改译文：原译是另一版本的句子且残缺，按英文重译

30133§priory§ˈpraɪəri§n. 小修道院（由 prior 主持、附属于大修道院）§But his conflict with Sempringham Priory must be seen as an indirect result of a property dispute involving land on which his manor sat: he was taking property to which he thought he had a right.§但他与 Sempringham **小修道院**的冲突，必须被视为一场涉及其庄园所在土地的产权纠纷的间接结果：他取走的是他认为自己有权拥有的财产。§§§§§规模小于 abbey（大修道院）；真题中 Sempringham Priory 是产权纠纷的一方，属机构名词§改译文：原译含英文没有的「权属含糊」「真诚相信」，漏了「庄园所在土地」

30134§proponent§prəˈpəʊnənt§n. 支持者；倡导者§Some proponents of the hypothesis argue that iron production technologies first arrived in North Africa through Carthage, where the earliest evidence of ironworking dates to approximately 800–600 BCE, before these technologies spread to sub-Saharan Africa over the following centuries.§该假说的一些**支持者**主张，冶铁技术最初是经由迦太基传入北非的——那里最早的冶铁证据可追溯到约公元前 800 至 600 年——之后这些技术才传播到撒哈拉以南非洲。§§§pro-（赞成、向前）+ pon（放置）+ -ent（人）§a proponent of X X 的支持者；opponent n. 对手；反对者（反义，形近）；advocate n. 倡导者；supporter n. 支持者（近义替换）§§

30135§propriety§prəˈpraɪəti§n. 得体；适当；规矩；（复数）礼节§Comfortable they certainly were, but neither gorgeous nor even grand; indeed, considering the money that had been spent there, the eye and taste might have been better served; there was an air of heaviness about the rooms which might have been avoided without any sacrifice of propriety; colours might have been better chosen and lights more perfectly diffused; but perhaps in doing so the thorough clerical aspect of the whole might have been somewhat marred.§那些房间当然舒适，却谈不上华丽，甚至也不算宏伟；的确，考虑到在这里花掉的钱，本可以更好地满足眼睛与品味；房间里有一种沉闷之气，本可以在丝毫不失**体统**的前提下避免；颜色本可以选得更好，灯光本可以散布得更匀；但若真这样做，整体那种十足的教士气息或许就会有所折损。§§§§propriety of demeanour 举止得体；proprieties n. （社交）礼节、规矩；proper adj. 适当的；properly adv. 适当地§propriety ≠ property：后者是「财产；属性」，形近异义§改译文：原译是另一段（讲弟弟们）的翻译，按英文重译

30136§quasar§ˈkweɪzɑː§n. 类星体§Quasars range in age, with approximately 200 of them known to have developed within the first billion years of the formation of the universe.§**类星体**的年龄各不相同，已知约有 200 个是在宇宙形成后的最初十亿年内出现的。§Quasars—such as QSO J0005-0006, located in the Pisces constellation—are extremely luminous galactic nuclei powered by supermassive black holes.§**类星体**——如位于双鱼座方向的 QSO J0005-0006——是极其明亮的星系核，由超大质量黑洞供能。§quasar ← quasi-stellar radio source（类星射电源）§quasi- 前缀 类似、准（如 quasi-scientific 准科学的）§§

30137§ratify§ˈrætɪfaɪ§v. 正式批准；使（条约、宪法、协议）生效§They were published pseudonymously in the Independent Journal and other New York newspapers in 1787-88 and argue that New Yorkers should vote to ratify the proposed United States Constitution.§这些文章于 1787—1788 年以笔名发表在《独立日报》及其他纽约报纸上，主张纽约人应当投票**批准**拟议中的美国宪法。§Ratified in 2017 by two-thirds of World Trade Organization member nations, the Trade Facilitation Agreement (TFA) is a trade-reform measure that aims to reduce redundant customs procedures and other costly aspects of international trade.§《贸易便利化协定》（TFA）于 2017 年获世界贸易组织三分之二成员国**批准**，是一项贸易改革措施，旨在精简冗余的海关程序并降低国际贸易的其他成本。§§ratification n. 正式批准§ratify 强调「有权机构正式批准」，approve 只是「同意」；ratify ≠ rectify：后者是「纠正、矫正」§

30138§realist§ˈrɪəlɪst§n. 现实主义者；现实主义作家 / 画家 adj. 现实主义的§This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors around the world, including Keri Hulme, whose 1984 novel The Bone People resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with cultural traditions—namely, those of the Maori, the Indigenous people of New Zealand.§这一风格对世界各地的作家产生了决定性影响，其中包括 Keri Hulme：她 1984 年的小说《骨中人》（The Bone People）把文学现实主义与毛利人（新西兰原住民）的文化传统并置，酷似经典的魔幻**现实主义**小说。§This style has exerted a decisive influence on authors in the United States, including Toni Morrison, whose 1987 novel Beloved resembles classic magical realist novels in its juxtaposition of literary realism with long-established cultural traditions—namely, those of the Black American community.§这一风格对美国作家产生了决定性影响，其中包括托妮·莫里森——她 1987 年的小说《宠儿》将文学现实主义与源远流长的文化传统（即非裔美国人社区的传统）并置，酷似经典的魔幻**现实主义**小说。§§magical realist novels 魔幻现实主义小说（真题高频）；realism n. 现实主义；realistic adj. 现实主义的；务实的§realist ≠ royalist：后者是「保王党人」，形近§

30139§remnant§ˈremnənt§n. 残余；剩余部分；遗迹§Some researchers posit that the species inhabiting the South Pacific island of Grande Terre belong to clades that predate the island’s split from remnants of the former supercontinent Gondwana around 80 million years ago.§一些研究者假定，栖息于南太平洋格朗德特尔岛的物种所属的演化支，其出现时间早于该岛约 8000 万年前从前超大陆冈瓦纳的**残余部分**分裂出去的时间。§Wang and colleagues recovered microscopic remnants of turmeric and other spices from the surfaces of the tools.§Wang 及同事从工具表面提取出了姜黄等香料的微观**残留物**。§§remnants of a supercontinent 超大陆的残余部分（真题搭配）；remain v. 剩余；remainder n. 余数；剩余物§remnant 强调「大块消失后剩下的小块」，remainder 是数学上的「余数」§

30140§repudiate§rɪˈpjuːdieɪt§v. 拒绝接受；否认；断然驳斥（主张、说法、责任）§It had seemed like a big lot until now, but now the very idea that all that fury and motion should be transpiring inside any one fence was something to be repudiated with contempt, like a mirror trick.§直到此刻之前，那似乎还是好大一片地方；可现在，想到所有的狂暴与骚动竟都发生在某一道栅栏之内，这念头就成了应当带着轻蔑予以**拒斥**的东西，如同镜子的戏法一般。§§§§repudiation n. 否认；拒绝接受§比 reject 更重，含「与之划清界限」的意味；refute 是「用证据反驳」，repudiate 是「拒绝承认」§

30142§roost§ruːst§n. （鸟类）夜栖处；栖架 v. 栖息§The two leading explanations for this behavior are the “warmer together” hypothesis, which holds that the goal is to attract more starlings to increase body heat in cold roosts, and the “safer together” hypothesis, which centers on defenses like crowding to make it hard for peregrine falcons and other predators to target a single bird.§对这一行为的两种主流解释是「抱团取暖」假说（目标是招来更多椋鸟以在寒冷**栖息地**提升体温）与「抱团更安全」假说（侧重挤成一团，让游隼等捕食者难以锁定单只鸟）。§But the lack of trees on such farms means a lack of spaces for many species of birds to roost.§但这类农场缺乏树木，也就意味着许多鸟类物种缺少**栖息**的场所。§§cold roosts 寒冷的夜栖点；come home to roost 恶果回落到自己身上；rule the roost 当家作主§§

30143§salient§ˈseɪliənt§adj. 显著的；突出的；最值得注意的§In this case, players’ cognitive resources are directed foremost toward the advergame's mechanics, leaving little or no capacity for encoding and storing the information the advertiser intends to be salient.§在这种情况下，玩家的认知资源首先被广告游戏的玩法机制占去，几乎没有余力去编码和储存广告主原本想让它**凸显**出来的信息。§The researchers ran their model twice under different assumptions, concluding that emphasizing the salience of local population density over personal preferences generally yielded the best results.§研究者在不同假设下把模型运行了两次，得出结论：强调本地人口密度的**显著性**、使其优先于个人偏好，总体上效果最好。§§salient point 要点；salience n. 显著性（真题出现 1 次）§与 prominent 相比，salient 更强调「在众多信息中被优先注意到」§改译文：删去英文没有的「想让人记住」；补译文2

30144§scarcity§ˈskeəsəti§n. 稀缺；不足；匮乏；（经济学）稀缺性§This relative scarcity made it all the more exciting when the team examined remains of well-preserved organic artifacts discovered in a cave in Spain and determined that they dated even further back than previously thought.§正因为相对**稀缺**，当研究团队检视在西班牙一处洞穴中发现的保存完好的有机器物残件、并确定其年代比先前认为的更为久远时，才格外令人振奋。§Under drought conditions, wheat plants produce smaller leaves, a common response to water scarcity that limits transpirational water loss and helps maintain osmotic balance.§在干旱条件下，小麦的叶片长得更小——这是应对水分**短缺**的常见反应，可限制蒸腾失水并帮助维持渗透平衡。§§scarcity of X X 的稀缺；scarce adj. 稀缺的；scarcely adv. 几乎不§scarcity 是长期结构性稀缺，shortage 是短期短缺；与 abundance（丰富）相对§
